name: Ange
source:
A girl who helps people without recompense. Ange works in a farm and does voluntary jobs such as cleaning everywhere in the city. Insistently invites and tries to force the protagonist to step on the way of God.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
